suhoor_toast: You eat bread and dates by lamplight before Fajr.
iftar_button: Break your fast with the people

iftar.title: Iftar
iftar.text: Yunus calls the adhan from the roof. Idris passes you a date and a cup of water. The men who sold you pepper this morning sit beside you on the mats, and nobody is a stranger tonight.

tarawih_toast: You stand behind Idris for the night prayer. The masjid is full and the Quran fills it.
